name: Grim Message
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
The Witherbark trolls were once allies to the Horde, but they betrayed Thrall... and that must be punished!

Here, take my pike and go to the Hinterlands, far to the north.  You will find it northeast of Tarren Mill, a village held by our allies, the Forsaken.

When you enter the Hinterlands, hunt Witherbark trolls.  Gather their skulls and drive my pike into the ground at one of their smaller villages, Hiri'watha or Zun'watha.

Show them their vile actions are of consequence!
narrative.objectives: Gather Witherbark Skulls and place on Nimboya's Pike.  Place Nimboya's Laden Pike at one of the Witherbark Villages in the Hinterlands, then return to Nimboya in Stranglethorn.
narrative.offerRewardText: Word reached me of your deed. A grim deed, but one of honor. Let us hope the Witherbarks heed your message.
narrative.requestItemsText: You have not completed my task, adventurer.
